koi_total_rows.adql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM cumulative
koi_total_rows.description: Total rows in the Kepler KOI cumulative table (NASA Exoplanet Archive)

koi_disposition_counts.adql: SELECT koi_disposition, COUNT(*) AS n FROM cumulative GROUP BY koi_disposition
koi_disposition_counts.description: Count of KOI entries by koi_disposition in cumulative table

koi_fp_fraction.adql: SELECT koi_disposition, COUNT(*) AS n FROM cumulative GROUP BY koi_disposition
koi_fp_fraction.description: False-positive fraction of KOI cumulative table (FALSE POSITIVE / total_rows × 100, rounded to 1 d.p.)

toi_disposition_counts.adql: SELECT tfopwg_disp, COUNT(*) AS n FROM toi GROUP BY tfopwg_disp
toi_disposition_counts.description: Count of TESS TOI entries by tfopwg_disp in toi table
